title: The Star-Wheel as Binding-Engine
description: The four ordered receptacles into which the captured archonic host was distributed — firmaments above, eight earths below, encampments and strongholds around, and the star-sphere itself — with the central image of the third-kind powers bound onto the turning Wheel. Spirit and Living Fire receive ascending light from below and cast falling residue downward; the king is equal with his comitatus, the seven guides and twelve zodiac signs imprisoned and made to serve the redemption.
